purpose: The developer's own published description of the building and of the handover ('под чистовую отделку') condition. Authoritative for structure, ceiling height, external wall build-up and what is already installed at handover - none of which was recorded anywhere before 2026-09-04.

provenance.source: developer's published building description, supplied verbatim by the owner 2026-09-04
provenance.status: authoritative for the BUILDING; not a field measurement of this flat
provenance.verbatim: Дом каркасно-блочный многоквартирный 21-этажный  с 1-2-3-4-комнатными квартирами. Характеристики и особенности домов жилого комплекса: монолитный железобетонный каркас с наружными стенами (не несущие) из блоков ячеистого бетона толщиной 300мм, утепленными минераловатными плитами толщиной 70мм с дальнейшим их оштукатуриванием и покраской, высота потолков в квартирах 2,5 метра (21-й этаж 3 метра), в каждом подъезде 3 лифта (пассажирский и два грузопассажирских), кладовые помещения в подвальном этаже, входы в подъезды расположены с внутренней стороны домов. Внутренняя отделка квартир: квартиры подготовлены под «чистовую» отделку: установлены межкомнатные перегородки (кроме 1-комнатных квартир), выполнено выравнивание и штукатурка стен, стяжка пола, разводка электрики и подводка оптоволокна, установлены розетки и выключатели, радиаторы отопления, унитаз, выполнено остекление лоджий, окна — 2-камерные стеклопакеты ПВХ; выполнена горизонтальная разводка труб отопления с установкой счетчиков тепла.

lifts_per_entrance.why_it_matters: !! Directly answers a Round 7 finding: the specify-large-and-cut technique's third motive is LIFT ACCESS, and the cut dimension derives from the INSTALLED height. Two goods/passenger lifts means large panels and full-height joinery can be brought up - so that constraint is relaxed here. Confirm the goods lift's internal dimensions before relying on it.

building.basement_storage_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: this flat does NOT get a basement store. !! So the лоджия must absorb the whole DIY/hobby storage brief on its own, and its 6.05 m² (4.24 counted) is the only non-room storage volume the household has.
building.entrances_note: Entrances are on the inner side of the buildings.

ceiling_height_mm.status: !! NOT RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS REPO BEFORE 2026-09-04, and it changes answers.
ceiling_height_mm.conflict_note: The vault's own rule (Zemskov) states the minimum COMFORTABLE ceiling height is 2.8 m. This flat has 2.5 m - 300 mm below it. That is not a contradiction to resolve; it is a constraint to design within, and it invalidates or qualifies anything in the vault that assumed a void.

datum_settled_2026_09_04.answer: THE 2500 IS SCREED TO CEILING - i.e. it is the CLEAR height, not slab to slab.
datum_settled_2026_09_04.owner_words: "let's assume it's from screed to ceiling. From slab to slab, it would be plus five or something centimeters on top of that."
datum_settled_2026_09_04.status: The owner's reading rather than a quoted document - but a sound one: a developer advertising «2,5 метра» means clear height, and slab-to-slab would make the advertised figure misleading. Recorded as the working assumption.
datum_settled_2026_09_04.why_it_is_the_FAVOURABLE_answer: !! It means the 2500 is USABLE height. The earlier caution - that if it were slab-to-slab every surface area on the schedule would be 2-4% high - does not apply.
datum_settled_2026_09_04.the_one_deduction_that_remains: ⚠ THE FLOOR COVERING SITS ON TOP OF THE SCREED, so the FINISHED clear height is slightly under 2500: porcelain tile + adhesive ~18 mm, engineered board + underlay ~17, quartz-vinyl ~8. So ~2482-2492 finished, call it 2480-2490.
datum_settled_2026_09_04.TWO_HEIGHTS_ARE_NEEDED_FOR_QUANTITIES: !! Not one. PLASTER / RENDER area uses 2500, because it runs down to the screed and is applied before the floor. PAINTED / VISIBLE area uses ~2480, finished floor to ceiling, less the skirting. A surface-area model that uses a single height will be wrong for one of the two trades.

knock_on_figures.duct_route_finished_clear_mm: 2282-2332 (2500 less 150-200 of duct, less the floor covering)
knock_on_figures.door_head_band_mm: 430 from the screed above a 2070 opening; ~412 finished

external_walls.load_bearing_note: !! The developer states the external walls are NOT load-bearing - the monolithic frame carries everything. So the only truly immovable structure is the frame itself (plus the common-property shafts and risers).

insulation.position: EXTERNAL - «с дальнейшим их оштукатуриванием и покраской», i.e. rendered and painted over on the outside
insulation.consequence: !! ANSWERS AN OPEN QUESTION: the insulation is OUTSIDE. It does NOT eat internal clear dimensions - it grows the envelope outward. The owner's recollection of '70 to another 100+ mm' matches: 70 mm of wool plus render.

external_walls.model_rule: Insulation is a LAYER on the wall, never a wall in its own right. Adding it as a wall would corrupt the shell and everything derived from it.

windows.spec_en: PVC frames with double-chamber (three-pane) sealed units

already_installed: межкомнатные перегородки (кроме 1-комнатных квартир) - INTERNAL PARTITIONS ARE BUILT; this flat is a 3-room so they apply
выравнивание и штукатурка стен - walls levelled and plastered
разводка электрики и подводка оптоволокна - electrical distribution and fibre
розетки и выключатели - sockets and switches fitted
горизонтальная разводка труб отопления с установкой счетчиков тепла - horizontal heating distribution with HEAT METERS
handover_condition.heat_meters_note: !! Heat meters need periodic reading, and the vault holds a finding from its closest comparable that a CONCEALED hatch over monthly-read meters is the exact configuration that fails - at that frequency the hatch is simply left ajar. Whatever encloses these meters must be openable without ceremony.
handover_condition.loggia_glazing_note: The developer glazes the лоджия. The owner's own brief is to REPLACE that glazing with proper insulated units to reach a frost-free-without-heating target - so this is a rip-out-and-replace item, not an absence to fill.
handover_condition.screed_note: The screed is already laid and the heating pipes are distributed horizontally, most likely within it. So there is NO height to recover from the floor - which matters because there is only 2500 mm to begin with.

flat_in_building.source: _Inbox/_Visual_Drop/building_floor_plan_appartment_highlighted.jpg - the block floor plan with this flat outlined in red by the owner, 2026-09-04. Read in the same orientation as the individual flat plans.
flat_in_building.position: THE END FLAT at the right-hand end of the block. Type 3Б/2+ on this drawing.
flat_in_building.building_composition: The building is TWO similar blocks. The block to the right is a MIRROR of this one. !! THAT IS THE MECHANISM BEHIND THE LEFT/RIGHT HANDEDNESS PROBLEM already recorded: two mirrored blocks means flats of the same layout exist in both handednesses, which is why a measured comparable may be flipped.

walls_by_context.bottom: THE ONLY EXTERNAL WALL. Carries the windows of all three rooms plus the лоджия. This is where the 300 mm block + 70 mm external mineral wool build-up applies - and nowhere else.
walls_by_context.right: THE BLOCK END -> the future party wall between the two blocks. Owner: his leaf is 200-250 mm (he trusts the drawing over his recollection), the adjacent block adds another 200 mm, with a special seam between them, for roughly 400 mm total.
walls_by_context.left: Party wall to the neighbouring flat within this block.
walls_by_context.top: Changes neighbour along its length: the common corridor at the entrance end, the flat above (2Г/2) further along. !! This explains the owner G2 | R3 | G3 marking - one wall, three segments, because it has more than one neighbour.

flat_in_building.party_wall_confirmation: !! THIS SETTLES THE OPEN QUESTION about the green perimeter runs. Three of the flat four sides are PARTY walls - to a neighbour flat, to the common corridor, or to the adjacent block. None of them is external. So the green marking is consistent throughout, and "up to ~200 between the apartments" refers to exactly these.

inter_block_wall.composition: this flat leaf 200-250 + expansion/settlement seam + adjacent block leaf 200
inter_block_wall.affects: the living room (19.49) and the кухня (5.24)
inter_block_wall.acoustics: !! A GENUINE DECOUPLED DOUBLE WALL, acquired for nothing. The vault records a soundproofing stopping rule - about +20% quieter for about 10x the cost - and the best performing wall in this flat needs no spend at all. Any soundproofing budget belongs on the OTHER walls: the in-block party wall on the left, and the corridor wall.
inter_block_wall.constraint: Nothing may be chased into or fixed through the seam, and any niche or recess must stay within this flat own 200-250 mm leaf.

daylight_and_aspect.aspect: SINGLE-ASPECT. All glazing is on the bottom façade, plus the лоджия off the 9.36 m² room.
daylight_and_aspect.kitchen_note: !! THE DEVELOPER KITCHEN IS WINDOWLESS - confirmed from the block plan: its top wall borders the flat above and its right wall is the block end, so it has no external wall at all.
daylight_and_aspect.cross_ventilation: NONE POSSIBLE. A single-aspect flat cannot be cross-ventilated, which makes mechanical fresh air a requirement rather than an upgrade - and that collides with the 2500 mm ceiling. See the ducting page.

orientation.datum: The red arrow on the block floor plan points to the plan's LOWER-LEFT, and that is SOUTH.
orientation.derivation: bearing = (45 - math_angle) mod 360, fixed by that one datum.
consequences: !! THE ЛОДЖИЯ GLAZING FACES DUE SOUTH - the most solar-exposed element in the flat. That is the best possible result for the owner stated target of keeping it frost-free through a Belarusian winter with no heating, on passive insulation alone, and it should be an input to that calculation rather than an afterthought.
The three rooms face SE: morning to early-afternoon sun, and NO west-facing late-afternoon overheating. Solar shading is a morning problem here, not an evening one.

!! But SE glazing plus NO cross-ventilation (single-aspect) means summer heat cannot be purged by a cross-draught. That strengthens the case for cooling, and the owner has already raised routing an AC line - which is why the concrete/block map matters, since a chase cannot pass through the frame.

Only the SE façade and the S лоджия are external; the other three sides are party walls. Combined with a warm orientation, the flat is thermally very well placed - relevant to sizing anything, and a reason not to copy heat-loss assumptions from a source about a corner flat with two cold façades.

flat_in_building.access: The lift core and stairs are in the centre of the block; this flat is at the far end of the corridor from them. A carry distance for materials and for anything the goods lift delivers.

neighbours_and_adjacency.source: Owner assembled the two blocks and mirrored the second, 2026-09-04, and supplied the screenshot; adjacency read off the block floor plan.

across_the_block_joint_right.neighbour: AN IDENTICAL 3Б/2+, MIRRORED - the same flat type as this one, reflected.
across_the_block_joint_right.consequence: Because a mirror maps the joint-adjacent side to the joint-adjacent side, the rooms pair with their own counterparts: LIVING ROOM faces LIVING ROOM and КУХНЯ faces КУХНЯ across the joint.
across_the_block_joint_right.wet_rooms_at_the_joint: NONE, on either side. Both flats carry their wet block at the end AWAY from the joint, so no bathroom and no riser stands against this wall.
across_the_block_joint_right.verdict: !! THE BEST POSSIBLE ADJACENCY, across the best wall in the flat: habitable-to-habitable, no services, over a ~400 mm decoupled double wall with a seam. Needs no spend.

in_block_neighbour_left.neighbour: A different flat type (rooms 14.64 / 18.74 on the block plan).
in_block_neighbour_left.upper_portion: WET-TO-WET, which is the correct pairing: their 4.43 m² combined bathroom - WC pan, basin and bath - sits directly across the wall from this flat's туалет 1.42 and the top of ванная 3.09. Their bath is against the wall.
in_block_neighbour_left.lower_portion: !! THE ONE UNFAVOURABLE ADJACENCY IN THE FLAT: their habitable room 14.64 sits directly across the party wall from THIS FLAT'S 9.36 m² ROOM - which is the adults' bedroom in Phase 1 and the boy's room in Phase 2. A habitable room against a bedroom is the classic bad pairing, and if 14.64 is their living room it is the worst case. THEIR ROOM'S FUNCTION IS UNKNOWN from the plan.

neighbours_and_adjacency.top_wall: The common corridor at the entrance end, then the flat above (2Г/2) further along. The lift core is down that corridor and this flat is at its far end, so corridor traffic passes.
soundproofing_priority: 1. HIGHEST - the left party wall's LOWER portion, where the 9.36 room meets the neighbour's 14.64 habitable room. This is a bedroom in both project phases.
2. The top wall at the corridor end - passing traffic to and from the lifts.
3. The slabs above and below - impact noise, a different problem and not a wall.
4. NOT the block-joint wall - it is already a decoupled double wall and is the best-performing element in the flat.
5. NOT the wet-to-wet upper portion of the left wall - that is the correct pairing already, and water noise against a туалет/ванная is where it belongs.

quietest_room_by_position.why: !! IT HAS NO PARTY WALLS AT ALL. Both its side walls are internal to this flat (to the 9.36 room and to the living room), its top is the прихожая, and its bottom is the façade with a window. So it is the acoustically most protected habitable room in the flat, and it is glazed.
quietest_room_by_position.consequence: This satisfies the vault's own rule kids.quietest_brightest_room - the kids' room should be the quietest and brightest - and v1 already puts the children there. A fourth independent argument for a choice the owner made on other grounds.
